pn: Panāda 01. a mythical king, who succeeded Mahā Patāpa and was himself succeeded by Mahā Panāda. Mhv.ii.4; Dpv.iii.7..

Panāda 02. One of the chief Yakkhas to be invoked by the Buddha’s followers in time of need (DN.iii.204). He is also mentioned in the Mahā Samayasutta (DN.ii.258). Buddhaghosa says (DN-a.ii.688) that Panāda was a Gandhabba.
